svg.title: agentflow system architecture
svg.desc: Sources reach the gateway and triggers. Triggers publish events to Redis Streams, the orchestrator consumes them and runs steps on agent-runner, connectors, renderer and the internal sandbox. Postgres is the system of record and MLflow tracks runs.

g.font-family: Switzer, Inter, 'SF Pro Text', -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
